body_lead: Bengaluru, India — September 26, 2025: Karnataka Health Minister Shri Dinesh Gundu Rao today inaugurated Docbrella, a next-generation health tech platform, at its Bengaluru launch. This marks a bold step toward transforming healthcare in the state. The event was further enriched by Mr. Pranab Mohanty, Director General of Police (Internal Security & Cyber Command), Government of Karnataka, as the Chief Speaker, who underscored the urgent need for innovation and trust in India’s healthcare journey.
